vod-sos.l: Days since transplant (every definition is written around this count)
Hepatomegaly or right upper quadrant pain of liver origin (the modified Seattle wording)
Painful hepatomegaly (the Baltimore and EBMT wording; it satisfies the broader item above as well)
Hemodynamic or ultrasound evidence of veno-occlusive disease (a late-onset route beyond day 21)
Histologically proven (a late-onset route beyond day 21)
